name: Citadel Packaging Company
old_description: Citadel Packaging is a distributor of rigid container and packaging materials. We are a young company, founded in 2018, but we have the knowledge and expertise of an industry veteran. Our headquarters are in Meridian, Idaho, but our products are shipped all over the world. We pride ourselves on providing excellent customer service and supplying our customers with the best possible products available on the market.
about:
Founded in 2018 in Meridian, Idaho, Citadel Packaging Company operates as a distributor of rigid containers and packaging materials, shipping worldwide from its Idaho base. The young company draws on the experience of an industry veteran to serve customers across the globe.

The company stocks over 1,200 rigid container and closure products, including plastic bottles and jars, glass bottles and jars, metal tins and aluminum bottles, and a range of closures such as continuous-thread caps, dispensing caps, metal caps, and child-resistant caps. Orders ship within one to two business days, and volume pricing is displayed on product pages. Free samples are available directly from product pages.

Citadel serves startups, scaling brands, and established companies seeking rigid packaging solutions. The company emphasizes free samples and specialist support for bulk orders, positioning itself as a one-stop source for containers and closures.

The company highlights its combination of industry expertise and personal service, offering free samples, rapid shipping, and volume discounts as key differentiators. Real-person customer support is available by phone and email for questions about sizes, liners, or large-volume needs.
